description: $0.002 per call (x402, USDC on Base; add "trial": true to try up to 3 calls per IP per day free on tools up to $0.005; otherwise the call returns the payment terms: pay and retry with _meta["x402/payment"]). [Data utilities] Finds URLs, domains, dates (ISO, written and numeric, ambiguous ones flagged with both readings, as ISO 8601), money amounts with currency, percentages, numbers and hashtags in text you send, each with position and occurrences. Email addresses and phone-like numbers only when listed in types; nothing is looked up or stored; names and addresses are never extracted. Input: text (POST for long text), optional types, max_items. Limit: 400,000 characters. Offline.

text.description: Plain text or Markdown, 1-400,000 characters (short text in the query; long text as POST JSON {"text": "..."})

types.description: Comma list of: urls, domains, emails, phones, dates, money, percentages, numbers, hashtags. Default: urls, domains, dates, money, percentages, numbers, hashtags (emails and phones only when listed)

name: text_extract
title: Text extraction: URLs, dates, money, numbers and more
